astronomical_reference.source: University of Nebraska–Lincoln NAAP Solar System Models
astronomical_reference.assumption: Geocentric tropical/sidereal ecliptic longitude difference of Mercury or Venus from Sun cannot exceed conservative angular elongation bounds. No astrology outcomes used.

method.zodiac_bins: 12 equal 30 degree signs; houses counted inclusively from Lagna in whole-sign interpretation
method.min_separation_formula: max(0, (minimum circular separation in sign indices - 1)*30 degrees)
method.not_applicable_to: Unequal quadrant houses/other historical bhava interpretations until independently evaluated; do not assert universal astronomical impossibility under every house scheme.

source_cases.user_translation: Saravali English35.154 physical PDF104, Moon/Sun/Mars in 7th; Venus/Jupiter/Mercury in 2nd
source_cases.original_source: Sanskrit35.155, older Jain printed and CSU, named Sun clear
source_cases.logic: Both planets always within ~28 deg of each other from Earth. Separated by at least 120 deg if in seventh and second whole signs.

source_cases.user_translation: Saravali English35.185 physical PDF106, Venus/Jupiter in ascendant and Sun in fourth; Mercury/Mars in second
source_cases.original_source: Sanskrit35.186, Jain printing and CSU, Mercury/Mars main wording vakragau (retrograde); footnoted alternate artha-gau (second-house)
source_cases.logic: Venus within ~48 deg of Sun, but whole-sign first versus fourth requires at least 60 deg; location variant for Mercury does not remove Sun/Venus conflict.

source_cases.user_translation: Saravali English35.185 Mercury and Mars in second
source_cases.original_source: Sanskrit35.186 second-house footnote variant only; main vakragau may mean both retrograde
source_cases.logic: Even if Venus were disregarded, Sun fourth/Mercury second requires ≥30 degrees, exceeding Mercury geocentric limit.

source_cases.user_translation: Sarvali Ch45 or Sarvartha Ch9 seven exalted
source_cases.original_source: Sun exalted Aries, Mercury exalted Virgo

six_planets_exalted.warning: NOT_EXCLUDED does not imply physically realizable. Further orbital coincidence and historical calculations needed; do not count as predictive support.

related_source_texts.context: Parallel verse in another electional text places Sun at Lagna, Moon seventh, Mercury/Jupiter/Venus second; textual similarity does not establish direct borrowing or authorship, and different target is king's departure instead of birth.
